base = open('model_ref.xml').read()

def load(xml):
    return mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(xml, {}) if True else None

    d.qpos += rng.normal(0,0.01,size=d.qpos.shape)

    t0=time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(n): mujoco.mj_step(m,d)
    dt=(time.perf_counter()-t0)/n*1e6

import mujoco, numpy as np
base = open('model_ref.xml').read()
FULL = mujoco.mjtState.mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS

def sim(model, seed, amp=0.01):
    d = mujoco.MjData(model)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    d.qpos += rng.normal(0, amp, size=d.qpos.shape)
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, d)
    n = int(2.0/model.opt.timestep)
    for _ in range(n): mujoco.mj_step(model, d)
    s = np.zeros(mujoco.mj_stateSize(model, FULL))
    mujoco.mj_getState(model, d, s, FULL)
    return s

ref = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(base)
# sensitivity: same seed but tiny amplitude difference -> indicates chaos
for seed in [0,1,2]:
    a = sim(ref, seed, 0.01)
    b = sim(ref, seed, 0.01+1e-9)
    c = sim(ref, seed, 0.01001)
    print(f"seed {seed}: |a-b|={np.abs(a-b).max():.3e}  |a-c|={np.abs(a-c).max():.3e}  |state|max={np.abs(a).max():.3f}")

# PGS
pgs = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(base.replace('<size memory="2M"/>','<size memory="2M"/><option solver="PGS" iterations="100"/>'))
for seed in [0,1,2,3,4]:
    a = sim(ref, seed); b = sim(pgs, seed)
    print(f"PGS seed {seed}: norm={np.linalg.norm(a-b):.3e} maxabs={np.abs(a-b).max():.3e} allclose={np.allclose(a,b,atol=1e-5)}")
EOF
